quotes.text: 第二个好汉，名唤邹润，是他侄儿，年纪与叔叔仿佛，二人争差不多，身材长大，天生一等异相，脑后一个肉瘤，以此人都唤他做“独角龙”。
邹渊、邹润各拔出短刀在手。

explicit_facts: Human Zou Run, nephew of Zou Yuan but approximately the same age, tall/large stature, a fleshy prominence at the back of his head; short knife appears in this chapter.
art_interpretations: Exact face, beard, hairstyle, red cloth, armor and prominence size are art design. Back-of-head contour is shown without a forehead horn; small-size anatomical readability still pending.
Side/three-quarter close portrait has no weapon; not a statement that every story state is unarmed or armored.
scope: Standard UI portrait candidate only, not production/native/whole-character acceptance.
